The Sewers of Ragni#000.src: Soldier! Good timing. We've been requestin' help for ages.

The Sewers of Ragni#001.src: With the corrupted hordes terrorisin' the Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.

The Sewers of Ragni#002.src: Issue is, a major sewer pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.

The Sewers of Ragni#003.src: I'm going to need ya to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#004.src: Here's the brief. We get in, deploy small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.

The Sewers of Ragni#005.src: We're usin' this side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... ya don't want to stray too far into that one.

The Sewers of Ragni#006.src: Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurkin'. Ready? Let's go!

The Sewers of Ragni#007.src: New Quest Started: The Sewers of {p}

The Sewers of Ragni#008.src: Good, ya caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.

The Sewers of Ragni#009.src: Our scouts've confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.

The Sewers of Ragni#010.src: I... we really don't want t' end up there.

The Sewers of Ragni#011.src: Here's a small explosive. I placed one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.

The Sewers of Ragni#014.src: Ah, you're alive! Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.

The Sewers of Ragni#015.src: ... ah. This sewer has some history, y'know. Back durin' the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.

The Sewers of Ragni#016.src: Let's get out of here. D'you still have the explosive I gave you?

The Sewers of Ragni#017.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, the {p} citizens are going to be happy.

The Sewers of Ragni#018.src: ... I don't know exactly what's in there, soldier.

The Sewers of Ragni#019.src: I can't stop you from explorin' the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.

The Sewers of Ragni#020.src: Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in 'em durin' a raid on {p}.

The Sewers of Ragni#021.src: His mother died in childbirth, but some people say she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.

The Sewers of Ragni#022.src: But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, an' good luck.

The Sewers of Ragni#024.src: Soldier! Good timing. We've been requesting help for ages.
The Sewers of Ragni#024.dst: Солдат! Вовремя. Мы уже целую вечность просим подмогу.
The Sewers of Ragni#024.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#025.src: With the corrupted hordes terrorising the Wynn Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#025.dst: Орды осквернённых терроризируют Wynn Plains, и всё больше людей переезжает в {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#025.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#026.src: Issue is, a major sewage pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.
The Sewers of Ragni#026.dst: Беда в том, что забило крупную сточную трубу. Неудивительно, что никто не брался.
The Sewers of Ragni#026.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#027.src: I'm going to need you to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.dst: Придётся тебе испачкать руки. Мне нужна помощь с засором.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#028.src: Here's the brief. We get in, deploy some small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.
The Sewers of Ragni#028.dst: Задача такая. Заходим, закладываем немного взрывчатки, выбиваем засор и уходим.
The Sewers of Ragni#028.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#029.src: We're using the side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... you don't want to stray too far into that one.
The Sewers of Ragni#029.dst: Пойдём через боковую трубу. А в ту, что побольше, под холмом… туда лучше далеко не соваться.
The Sewers of Ragni#029.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#030.src: Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurking. Ready? Let's go!
The Sewers of Ragni#030.dst: Будь там начеку. Затаиться там может что угодно. Ну что, вперёд!
The Sewers of Ragni#030.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#031.src: Enter the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#031.dst: Войди в канализацию в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] и найди засор.

The Sewers of Ragni#032.src: Explore the sewer and find the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#033.src: Good, you caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#033.dst: Хорошо, ты здесь. Смотри под ноги, солдат.
The Sewers of Ragni#033.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#034.src: Our scouts have confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.
The Sewers of Ragni#034.dst: Разведчики подтвердили, что тут чисто, но не туда свернёшь - и попадёшь в старую тюрьму.
The Sewers of Ragni#034.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#035.src: I... we really don't want to end up there.
The Sewers of Ragni#035.dst: Я… нам туда точно не надо.
The Sewers of Ragni#035.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#036.src: Anyway, I've found the blockage. It's right up ahead.
The Sewers of Ragni#036.dst: Как бы то ни было, засор я нашёл. Он прямо впереди.
The Sewers of Ragni#036.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#037.src: Here's a small explosive. I placed this one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.
The Sewers of Ragni#037.dst: Вот небольшой заряд. Один я уже заложил у засора; если его не хватит, используй этот.
The Sewers of Ragni#037.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#038.src: Find a way to fix the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#039.src: Find a way out of the spooky sewer.

The Sewers of Ragni#040.src: Ah, you're alive. Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.
The Sewers of Ragni#040.dst: А, с тобой всё в порядке. Похоже, мы недооценили объём стоков.
The Sewers of Ragni#040.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#041.src: I lost you for a bit back there. It's lucky we found each other, to be honest.
The Sewers of Ragni#041.dst: Я было тебя потерял. Честно, повезло, что мы снова вместе.
The Sewers of Ragni#041.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#042.src: ... ah. This sewer has some history, you know. Back during the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.
The Sewers of Ragni#042.dst: …ах. У этой канализации есть история. Во время набегов на {p} здесь, в старой тюрьме, прятали мирных жителей.
The Sewers of Ragni#042.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#043.src: Sometimes... sometimes it wasn't enough. Some say there are still... things roaming there. Left over from the slaughters.
The Sewers of Ragni#043.dst: Иногда… иногда этого было мало. Говорят, там до сих пор… что-то бродит. Оставшееся после резни.
The Sewers of Ragni#043.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#044.src: Let's get out of here. Do you still have the explosive I gave you?
The Sewers of Ragni#044.dst: Выбираемся. Взрывчатка, что я дал, ещё у тебя?
The Sewers of Ragni#044.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#045.src: Good, let's use it on this wall, it looks like we can break right through...
The Sewers of Ragni#045.dst: Хорошо, взорвём эту стену, похоже, её можно пробить насквозь…
The Sewers of Ragni#045.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#047.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, and the {p} citizens are going to be happy.
The Sewers of Ragni#047.dst: Фух! Похоже, первый взрыв прочистил трубу, и жители {p} будут довольны.
The Sewers of Ragni#047.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#048.src: And count yourself lucky we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some of the stories...
The Sewers of Ragni#048.dst: И считай, что тебе повезло: ничего особо мерзкого нам там не попалось. Некоторые истории…
The Sewers of Ragni#048.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#049.src: ... I don't exactly know what's in there, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#049.dst: …я и сам толком не знаю, что там, солдат.
The Sewers of Ragni#049.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#050.src: I can't stop you from exploring the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.
The Sewers of Ragni#050.dst: Не могу запретить тебе исследовать подземелье, но советую сперва снарядиться.
The Sewers of Ragni#050.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#051.src: Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in them during a raid on {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#051.dst: По легенде, Bob, легендарный воин, родился там во время набега на {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#051.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#052.src: His mother died in childbirth, but some people said she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.
The Sewers of Ragni#052.dst: Его мать умерла в родах, но говорят, она пролежала там годы. Гния. Ожидая.
The Sewers of Ragni#052.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#053.src: But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, and good luck.
The Sewers of Ragni#053.dst: Но это всего лишь байка! Спасибо за помощь, солдат, удачи.
The Sewers of Ragni#053.speaker: Jenprest
